# THE PRIORITREE-MULTI-USER ROUTE — THE COMPOSITION (keikaku, 2026-11-26)

## THE STAGES (5) — the cycle itself

**research** — THE IDENTITY GROUND, PINNED AND SOURCED (the full-team mandate: every discover seat its own discipline).
- entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green; the research fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.
- purpose: FIVE parallel packets over the identity ground and the sources, the claims lane at every source — tansa's identity census (the web tier's current identity surfaces line-pinned: the sitting chain's hidden carry, the deliberate lane's fresh forms, the register's operator field, the probe-era lanes [the picker, the judge page, the done page]; the session/identity landscape at the sources: Starlette's SessionMiddleware, the cookie forms); shindan's threat-model diagnosis (the session's own surface: fixation, hijack, the CSRF's composition, the shareable URL's fate, the id-binding residual's honest shape); rikai's mechanism maps (the candidates' internals: the signing, the cookie's forms [HttpOnly/SameSite/max-age], the session's composition with the tier key's verified class, the register's operator seam); keisan's arithmetic (the forms' costs, the concurrent-humans arithmetic, the knobs — the free-tier spirit); MOHO'S IDENTIFICATION WALK (R4 at the research gate: the current web surfaces walked as the human — FR-MEM-0041's cost the ground, the per-operation identification lived at every lane); togo's gated synthesis closing G-MULTI-USER-RESEARCH.

**evaluation** — THE BENCH OVER THE CANDIDATE IDENTITY MODELS.
- entry_condition: G-MULTI-USER-RESEARCH is green (the identity ground pinned, the sources ruled, the candidates mapped); the divergences reconcile at the design synthesis.
- purpose: FOUR parallel packets, every seat pricing the candidates against its own discipline — hyoka's adversarial attack (fixation, hijack, the CSRF's composition, the id-binding residual's new forms, the llm-class kill priced), moho's blind walks (the identification UX lived — FR-MEM-0041's cost the ground: the once-per-browser identification walked at every candidate), keisan's pricing (every candidate against the constraints: the free-tier spirit, the llm-class constraint, the configurability law, the honest residuals), shindan's residual diagnosis (every candidate's residual exposure: what remains reachable, the id-binding narrowed never erased); the divergences carried whole to the synthesis, never averaged away; the stage carries no gate of its own — its weight rides the design gate.

**recommendation** — THE DIVERGENCE RESOLVED AT FULL WEIGHT.
- entry_condition: the evaluation's packets landed whole — every candidate attacked, walked, priced, diagnosed.
- purpose: suisen's full-depth whole (the banked option (i) [the login/session form: identify once per browser, each browser its own voter] vs its priced alternatives (ii) the server-side key bare and (iii) the key-free child — RE-OPENED AT FULL WEIGHT, the lived cost now measured, never assumed; the concurrent-humans truth; the shareable URL's fate; the tiers' identity seams: the register's operator, the web's comparator, the session's composition with the tier key's verified class) + togo's gated synthesis integrating the whole bench's findings — closing G-MULTI-USER-DESIGN at the collaborator's ruling; MOHO'S WALK at the design gate (R4 — the effort's own ground is the UX: the recommended identification UX walked as the human will live it).

**build** — THE UNITS THE DESIGN EARNS (named not pinned).
- entry_condition: G-MULTI-USER-DESIGN is green — the design is the spec, the build set earned; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).
- purpose: the likely set named not pinned — the voter session (the likely FIRST unit: RUN-0008's completion rides its landing — the probe's dependency, the count gate standing at the probe store, the wait honest at both stores), the register/operator surfaces, the README's story — THE CYCLE'S OUTCOME RULES THE SET; the two-lane brief → spec → build per unit (G-<UNIT>-BRIEF → G-<UNITSPEC>-BRIEF → G-<UNIT>, minted at their turns — the build-add auto-stamp the pair's sole creator, FR-MEM-0034's poisoning lesson: never manually pre-compose synthesize/<unit>); the per-step dispatch (R8, the file-unit); kensho's independent verification per build gate; MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALKS at the user-facing units' build gates (R4); one-commit-per-increment; the ThreePart at every refusal; the llm-class constraint held at every surface (the session the HUMANS' lane — the llm votes ride unchanged at the stdio/tools tier); the configurability law at every knob from birth (the session secret, the cookie's forms); the free-tier spirit (the session prices its own infrastructure).

**close** — THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form).
- entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.
- purpose: hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake — FR-MEM-0041's resolution named), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry — the landing state named honestly; the probe's datum honest: RUN-0008's completion carried or its standing wait named; the banked shapes carried), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.

2. every choice cites its ruling: the convening ruling (the shape earned + the governance form, both verbatim, stated twice) + the standing constraints (the free-tier spirit, the llm-class constraint [the session the HUMANS' lane], the configurability law, the honest residuals) + the probe's dependency (RUN-0008 at 234/312 riding the session unit's landing) + the standing laws (R6/R11, R8, R4, the two-lane form, the claims lane, the ThreePart);

2. THE SOURCES RULED: the session/identity landscape researched whole at the sources (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, the cookie forms, the claims lane at every source — extract → research → verify → rule, each claim its own verdict: confirmed | refuted | priced-and-accepted | cured);
3. THE THREAT MODEL + THE ARITHMETIC LANDED: the session's own surface priced (fixation, hijack, the CSRF's composition, the shareable URL's fate, the id-binding residual's honest shape); the forms' costs and the concurrent-humans arithmetic at the free-tier spirit;

1. THE EVALUATION LANDED: the full bench's parallel packets over the mapped candidates (the adversarial attack, the blind walks [FR-MEM-0041's cost the ground], the pricing against the constraints, the residual diagnosis) — the divergences reconciled at the synthesis, never averaged away;
2. THE RECOMMENDATION LANDED: suisen's full-depth whole carrying the whole bench's findings — the banked divergence (option (i) vs its priced alternatives (ii)/(iii)) RESOLVED AT FULL WEIGHT, never assumed; the concurrent-humans truth, the shareable URL's fate, the tiers' identity seams all ruled;
3. THE DESIGN WALKED: moho's implementation walk at the design gate (R4 — the effort's own ground is the UX: the recommended identification UX walked as the human will live it, the findings riding the gate as evidence);
4. THE COLLABORATOR'S RULING ON THE FULL RECORD: the design judged publicly right — the build set earned by the cycle's outcome (the voter session the likely first unit, RUN-0008's completion riding its landing); the llm-class constraint held (the session the HUMANS' lane, the llm votes unchanged at the stdio/tools tier); the configurability law at every knob from birth (the session secret, the cookie's forms); the honest residuals named (the id-binding narrowed never erased); no build dispatch fires before it is green.

**G-<UNIT>-BRIEF / G-<UNITSPEC>-BRIEF** (collaborator-ruling, minted per unit at its turn) — the two-lane standing shape (the auth precedent): the brief (togo's synthesis over the unit's ungated discovery legs discover/<unit> + understand/<unit> + the approved design — the banked shapes, the scope fence, the return forms) and the spec (the bytes whole, every edit fenced, the per-file dispatch plan R8); the dispatches cite the approved brief/spec; the collaborator approves each — the fires come only after.

THE VOTER SESSION'S GATE carries the probe's completion key: RUN-0008's human half unblocks at its landing — the dependency honest at both stores.

**G-CLOSE** (collaborator-ruling) — the standing bookend: hansei's retro landed (the friction ledger the intake — FR-MEM-0041's resolution named, the lessons carried); the effort's records landed (the CONTINUATION entry, the landing state named honestly; the probe's datum honest either way — RUN-0008's completion carried or its standing wait named, never silent; the banked shapes carried); the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn, the route's status set done at the ruling.
